agent_discovery.description: Locate one visible item and the effector front in parallel, express both in rebot_arm_base, and plan an uncertainty-aware Cartesian correction to the requested no-contact destination. When the runtime supplies the canonical scene and Integrated controller, the adapter also requests a shadow preview and returns an exact separately authorized execution continuation. The default correction reaches the destination in one planned motion; both landmarks are observed again for residual realignment. This planning Skill never submits or authorizes motion.
when_to_use: The robot should move close to a visible item without touching or pushing it.
An Agent needs one correction from current visual item and effector evidence.
A previous correction completed and both landmarks must be realigned.
when_not_to_use: The item has only bearing evidence and no metric or task-plane point.
The camera-to-arm-base calibration is unavailable or stale.
The request intends contact, grasping, pushing, or force work.
side_effects: Reads synchronized RGB-D and arm-base transform evidence for two parallel locator calls.
May call the configured VLM twice in parallel and write diagnostic evidence images.
May request a nonphysical Integrated-controller shadow preview through the host adapter.
Returns an exact execution continuation but does not authorize or execute it.

question.description: Complete description of the one visible item to approach.

object_id.description: Optional stable object ID supplied by the upstream Agent.

maximum_step_m.description: Optional explicit correction cap. The default spans the complete 1.2 m arm ROI so normal requests target the destination rather than an arbitrary 5 cm segment.

vertical_policy.description: Vertical correction policy. FREE_3D relies on the required semantic-scene collision preview; PRESERVE_CURRENT_HEIGHT forces a horizontal correction.
